listing.name: Expanded Administrators 1.0.1
listing.summary: Adds new skills to, increases the level of, and adjusts salary values for, administrators. Skills are designed to be powerful and effective in ways structures/ai cores arent but expensive to run - making an Alpha Core an ideal stopgap for when you don't want to use an expensive administrator, or don't have one with the skillset you need.
